traits.accuracy: Transcript quality of live speech (incl. Japanese) as delivered by the stream.
traits.latency: How soon transcript text arrives relative to the speech (partials during the utterance score highest).
traits.privacy: Confidence that audio never leaves the machine (on-device execution by construction).

evidence: libs/core/streaming-stt-bridge.ts (StubStreamingSpeechToTextBridge emits synthetic 'stub-utterance-<n>' text; eligible only when synthetic output is allowed)
libs/core/shell-streaming-stt-bridge.ts (operator command from KYBERION_STT_COMMAND; may be a cloud CLI such as deepgram, so local_only is not declared)
scripts/stt_mlx_whisper_stream.py (resident whisper-large-v3-turbo, one final per 1.5 s window: text during speech, window cuts cost some accuracy)
libs/actuators/voice-actuator/src/voice-stt-backend-adapters.ts (loopback adapter: buffers the whole stream, then one mlx_whisper transcription)
libs/actuators/voice-actuator/src/voice-stt-backend-adapters.ts (loopback adapter: buffers the whole stream, then one faster-whisper transcription)

accuracy.description: Live minutes and captions people will read later; text may arrive after the utterance.

latency.description: Conversational turns and barge-in, where text must arrive during or right after the utterance.

privacy.description: Sensitive conversations: prefer on-device streams. Use the local_only requirement when remote processing must be impossible.
